title: Crispy Pizza Smashed Potatoes
steps: Boil. Cover the potatoes with water, add 1 tbsp salt and boil 10–15 minutes until just fork tender. Drain and cool slightly.
Smash. Score each potato in a criss-cross about halfway down, cover with a square of parchment and flatten with the bottom of a glass.
Crisp. Spray with oil, season with salt and pepper and air fry or roast 20–25 minutes until the edges are golden.
Top. Brush with marinara, add mozzarella and mini pepperonis, and return until melted and golden. Garnish with chili flakes.
notes: Recipe fetched from the creator's linked page: hungryhappens.net/crispy-pizza-smashed-potatoes
